author: Bobby Grayson
description:
Implemented transcoding from any encoding to UTF-8 before searching. Auto-detection for UTF-16 BOM. Trade-off: transcoding path loses literal optimizations but maintains correctness.

Sources:
- 8bbe58d: 'This feature works by transcoding the files to be searched from their source encoding to UTF-8... The fundamental problem with transcoding everything first is that literal optimizations are nearly negated... Fixes #1'
title: Added encoding support via encoding_rs with auto-detection
